text: 🏴‍☠️ All hands on deck! Vote on what Yarrtube builds next. Yarrtube tracks nothing, so your answers are the only map I've got: 2 minutes, anonymous. [Cast your vote](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdaxzIRvwH7ll-KS1bWEJbGk2cT5pR34nOqm_bIFDZ6lavaew/viewform)

🏴‍☠️ Yarrtube 0.10.0 drops anchor! Stow your channels and playlists into categories (Plex smart playlists included), every video now brings its own subtitles, and the web UI got a fresh coat of paint. [See what's new](https://github.com/sergigp/yarrtube/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [How to update](https://github.com/sergigp/yarrtube/blob/main/doc/INSTALLATION.md#updating)

🏴‍☠️ Yarrtube 0.9.0 has set sail! Shaped by your feedback and loaded with bug fixes. Thanks to everyone who reported, tested and contributed! [See what's new](https://github.com/sergigp/yarrtube/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [Upgrade guide](https://github.com/sergigp/yarrtube/blob/main/doc/UPGRADING-TO-0.9.0.md)
🏴‍☠️ Yarrtube is built in the open, and your feedback steers the ship! Spotted a bug or dreaming up a feature? [Open an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/sergigp/yarrtube/issues)
